title: Certify the complete Mez Systems design system
objective: Certify the completed repository, Figma companion and explicitly agreed current release scope across model use, accessibility, portability, governance and release operations, then assemble a later immutable candidate for final consumer transition while leaving deferred channels visibly uncertified.

included: multi-model benchmark and golden or anti-example evaluation
release governance and recurring health checks
deterministic assembly of a later candidate containing the completed system
exact human review of the later candidate before consumer transition
excluded: integrating or deploying the real website consumer
claiming certification beyond the explicitly agreed current release scope

acceptance: the complete system is benchmarked across named models and output classes
authority, accessibility, portability, onboarding, versioning and health-check results are explicit
known gaps and failed cases remain visible
the completed Figma and channel era is represented without changing rc.1
deterministic clean-copy proof and an exact human approval precede PORT-04

verification.passCondition: all core, Figma, channel, model, documentation and release checks pass from clean evidence
Olli approves the complete certification record and exact later candidate for final consumer transition

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Is the complete system and exact later candidate ready to enter the final real-consumer transition?

stopConditions: a benchmark, accessibility or portability failure is hidden
the frozen rc.1 bytes would be changed
the work enters or deploys a consumer repository before certification approval
notes: PORT-04 follows this task and is the final consumer transition, not an input to certification.
SEQ-PRODUCT-UI-FIRST-001 limits this certification pass to the agreed current release scope. Deferred channel families are not silently certified and remain future work.
UI-01 closed through H-UI-01-PRODUCT-UI-FOUNDATION on 28 July 2026 as an approved non-production foundation direction.

Olli closed H-CERT-01-SYSTEM-CERTIFICATION on 28 July 2026 over exact rc.2 manifest 129e0faab15173633987fe7c0c66bde982978f850c18b9689412968b718aa2e9; publication, deployment and production authority remain false.
